results.title: High-risk merchant categories
results.text:
# High-risk merchant categories

These merchant category codes (MCCs) are high risk and are always assigned risk tier **high**:

- 4722 Travel agencies (long delay between purchase and service)
- 5967 Direct marketing - inbound telemarketing
- 7995 Gambling

High-risk merchants need enhanced due diligence at onboarding and a quarterly review. A rolling reserve of **10%** of settled volume is held for 180 days.

results.title: Reserves
results.text:
# Reserves

Rolling reserves protect Northwind against losses. High-risk merchants hold a 10% rolling reserve for 180 days. Medium-risk merchants hold a 5% reserve for 90 days only if their chargeback ratio exceeded 0.9% in any of the last three months. Low-risk merchants have no reserve.

results.title: Chargeback reason codes
results.text:
# Chargeback reason codes

| Code | Meaning | Typical evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 10.4 | Fraud - card-absent environment | 3-D Secure authentication record, AVS/CVV match, device fingerprint |
| 12.6 | Duplicate processing | Proof the two transactions were for separate purchases |
| 13.1 | Merchandise or services not received | Delivery confirmation with date and address |
| 13.3 | Not as described or defective | Product description, customer communication, return policy |
| 13.7 | Cancelled merchandise or services | Cancellation policy shown at checkout, proof the customer did not cancel |

Fraud codes (10.x) count toward the fraud monitoring program as well as the chargeback ratio.

results.title: Chargeback monitoring thresholds
results.text:
# Chargeback monitoring thresholds

Northwind Payments measures each merchant's **chargeback ratio** for a period:

chargeback ratio = (number of chargebacks raised against the merchant's transactions from the period) ÷ (number of the merchant's transactions from the period with status 'approved') × 100

- Below 0.9%: normal. No action. - 0.9% to 1.8%: **monitoring**. The merchant is placed on the watch list and reviewed monthly. - Above 1.8%: **escalation**. Open a P1 risk ticket for the merchant within 2 business days. Refunded and declined transactions are excluded from the denominator. The ratio is reported as a percentage with two decimals.

results.title: Risk ticket priorities
results.text:
# Risk ticket priorities

- **P1**: chargeback ratio above 1.8%, or more than 5 open chargebacks on one merchant. Response within 2 business days. - **P2**: chargeback ratio between 0.9% and 1.8%, or a sudden decline-rate increase. Response within 5 business days. - **P3**: informational follow-ups. Response within 15 business days. Only analysts may open tickets. Viewers can read data but cannot create or change tickets.

results.title: Merchant onboarding
results.text:
# Merchant onboarding

New merchants are in a **probation period** for their first 90 days after the onboarded date.
During probation, payouts are delayed by 7 days and the chargeback thresholds are halved (monitoring at 0.45%, escalation at 0.9%).
